glosses: often preceded by "o"; an epithet for the Devil

examples.text: Tom tem um irmão gêmeo maligno.
examples.en: Tom has an evil twin brother.

examples.text: A bruxa má lançou um feitiço maligno no homem e o transformou num inseto.
examples.en: The wicked witch cast an evil spell on the man and turned him into an insect.
